It was first published in the July 2023 issue of ''[[Ciao]]'', released on June 2, 2023.[https://web.archive.org/web/20230820211528/https://www.shogakukan.co.jp/magazines/0613907123 Ciao July 2023 issue | Shogakukan] (Japanese; archive) It is based on the ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' episode ''[[HZ002|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two)]]''.
